title: Separation and purification of human PBMC from BUFFY COAT
author: Marco Cosentino
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bc5kiy4w

steps.title: Prepare Diluted Blood Sample
steps.instruction: Dilute the buffy coat blood sample with PBS 1X.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the required amount of buffy coat blood sample into a 50 ml conical tube.
Add an equal volume of PBS 1X and mix well.

steps.title: Layer Blood on Ficoll
steps.instruction: Carefully layer the diluted blood over Ficoll in a conical tube.

substeps.instruction: Place 3 mL of FICOLL in a 15 mL conical tube.
Using a glass Pasteur Pipette, carefully layer 12 mL of diluted blood on top of the FICOLL to reach a final volume of 15 ml.

steps.title: Centrifuge to Separate Layers
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples to isolate the mononuclear cell layer.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 400 x g for 40 minutes at room temperature (RT) without brake using an Allegra AVANTI 30 centrifuge.

steps.title: Collect Mononuclear Cell Layer
steps.instruction: Extract the mononuclear lymphocyte cell layer from the tube.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove the tubes to avoid disturbing the white, cloudy mononuclear cell layer located between the plasma and FICOLL.
Use a glass Pasteur pipette to transfer the mononuclear lymphocyte cell layer into another 15 ml conical tube.

steps.title: Wash Isolated PBMC
steps.instruction: Wash the isolated PBMC with PBS/FBS 2%.

substeps.instruction: Wash the PBMC with PBS/FBS 2% to a final volume of 10 ml.
Centrifuge at 300 x g for 10 minutes at RT.

steps.title: Perform Lysis Step
steps.instruction: Treat the PBMC pellet with Lysis Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatants.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of Lysis Buffer, then add another 9 mL of Lysis Buffer.
Immediately centrifuge the tubes at 100 x g for 10 minutes at RT.

steps.title: Final Wash and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet and resuspend in RPMI/FBS for counting.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 10 mL PBS/FBS 2%.
Centrifuge at 300 x g for 10 minutes at RT.
Remove supernatant and resuspend the obtained pellet in 10 mL of RPMI/FBS 10% for cell counting.

steps.title: Perform Manual Cell Count
steps.instruction: Check purity and count cells using Türk solution and a Bürker chamber.

substeps.instruction: Mix 10 µL of cell suspension with an equal amount of Türk solution (dilution factor = 2).
Incubate the mixture for 3 min at room temperature.
Place 10 µL of the mixture into a Bürker chamber.
View under an optical microscope at 40X magnification.
Count cells in the four corner squares and the central square, including those on the bottom and left-hand perimeters, but excluding those on the top and right-hand perimeters.

steps.title: Perform Automatic Cell Count (Optional)
steps.instruction: Use a Cellometer machine and Trypan Blue for automated counting and viability.

substeps.instruction: Take 10 µL of cell suspension and add an equal amount of Trypan Blue.
Place the entire volume into a counting chamber.
Insert the chamber into the Cellometer Auto T4 and count to determine cells/ml and % viability.

steps.title: Verify Purity via Flow Cytometry (Optional)
steps.instruction: Check PBMC suspension purity using a flow cytometer.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 0.5x10^6 PBMC in 500 µl of PBS.
Analyze using a BD FACSCelesta flow cytometer based on morphological parameters.
